name: biblio-audiobook-paired-v1

provenance.bug: BiblioBook only recognized a downloaded EPUB through the CURRENT live source inventory. When the source vanished / reordered / returned a different md5, the detail page forgot the durable local book and tried another acquisition. Healed by 38339f4 ("fix(biblio): stabilize downloaded book read journey"): refreshLocal() now scans Books.downloadedBooks() and matches normalized title+author (BiblioApi.pairKey) so the already-downloaded copy is recovered independent of live sources, and openBookSession/routeDownloadItem make the local path the session target id while preserving title+author.

note: Requires prepare_seed.py with the actual tagged AppData root: the production audiobook index stores absolute paths and the seed copier does not expand placeholders. No runtime acceptance claimed.
